related.title: NASA CFD：網格收斂、Richardson 外插與錯誤階數
related.titleEn: NASA CFD: grid convergence, Richardson extrapolation and false-order diagnosis
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收與物理假設一致；不可對所有非穩態資料要求邊界和為零。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Acceptance matches physical assumptions; arbitrary transient data need not have a zero boundary sum.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NASA CFD：網格收斂、Richardson 外插與錯誤階數」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付三網格差值、觀測階數、外插表與變更組的假設失敗紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NASA CFD: grid convergence, Richardson extrapolation and false-order diagnosis using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver grid differences, observed orders, extrapolation tables and a recorded assumption failure for the perturbed dataset, separating discretization verification from physical validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將正值與負值絕對量分組，再計淨值；同時算總絕對通量以說明不同診斷代表不同量。
計算相鄰差 0.12 與 0.03，再以 log2 四取得二；檢查單調性與差值符號。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Group inflows and outflow magnitudes, then compute their difference. Also calculate absolute throughput and explain why absolute flux, net flux and local continuity errors are different diagnostics rather than interchangeable totals.
Calculate adjacent differences 0.12 and 0.03, then obtain order two from log2 of four. Check monotonicity and signs before using an order formula that assumes the supplied convergence pattern.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SuperLU：後向誤差、條件數與精化結果
related.titleEn: SuperLU: backward error, conditioning and refinement evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收與物理假設一致；不可對所有非穩態資料要求邊界和為零。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Acceptance matches physical assumptions; arbitrary transient data need not have a zero boundary sum.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「SuperLU：後向誤差、條件數與精化結果」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付原系統殘差、兩種誤差表、條件數討論及精化可重現輸入。
related.differenceEn: Investigate SuperLU: backward error, conditioning and refinement evidence using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver original-system residuals, backward and forward error tables, conditioning analysis and reproducible refinement inputs with exact versus floating-point arithmetic clearly distinguished.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將正值與負值絕對量分組，再計淨值；同時算總絕對通量以說明不同診斷代表不同量。
算殘差 [−0.01,1]，取最大絕對值一；分母為 1000×1.01+1000，再比較解誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Group inflows and outflow magnitudes, then compute their difference. Also calculate absolute throughput and explain why absolute flux, net flux and local continuity errors are different diagnostics rather than interchangeable totals.

Compute residual [-0.01,1] and its infinity norm one. Form denominator 1000*1.01+1000, then separately calculate the solution error relative to [1,1], preserving the distinction between the two diagnostics.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
